facebook.caption: Tourists walk right past this place. Locals don't. The day market at 49 Đường Ngô Quyền is where Phu Quoc residents actually shop. Fresh produce, local snacks, real prices. No English menus, no tourist markup. Just the island buying its groceries. If you want to eat like you live here, start here. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Inside the market locals use every morning. Fresh fruit, bagged spices, snacks you won't find at any resort shop. 49 Đường Ngô Quyền. Walk in, point, pay. That simple.
